title: Crestline Credit Card Promotional Financing: Plans, Minimum Purchases and Terms
content:
A Crestline Credit Card purchase made at a Crestline store can receive a promotional financing plan. Two kinds of plan exist: **deferred interest** plans of 6, 12 or 18 months, and **equal payment** plans of 24, 36 or 48 months at a reduced fixed APR. Which plans a product offers, and the smallest posted purchase that qualifies, differ by product.

## Plans offered

| Product | Plans offered |
|---|---|
| Crestline Auto Care Card Starter | 6-month deferred interest |
| Crestline Auto Care Card | 6- and 12-month deferred interest |
| Crestline Auto Care Card Preferred | 6-, 12- and 18-month deferred interest; 24-month equal payment |
| Crestline Auto Care Mastercard | 6- and 12-month deferred interest |
| Crestline Auto Care Mastercard Preferred | 6-, 12- and 18-month deferred interest; 24- and 36-month equal payment |
| Crestline Auto Care World Mastercard | all six plans |

## Smallest qualifying posted purchase (USD)

| Product | 6-month deferred | 12-month deferred | 18-month deferred | 24-month equal | 36-month equal | 48-month equal |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Crestline Auto Care Card Starter | 199 | 599 | 1,499 | 999 | 1,499 | 2,499 |
| Crestline Auto Care Card | 199 | 499 | 1,499 | 999 | 1,499 | 2,499 |
| Crestline Auto Care Card Preferred | 199 | 399 | 999 | 999 | 1,499 | 2,499 |
| Crestline Auto Care Mastercard | 199 | 499 | 1,499 | 999 | 1,499 | 2,499 |
| Crestline Auto Care Mastercard Preferred | 199 | 399 | 999 | 999 | 1,499 | 2,499 |
| Crestline Auto Care World Mastercard | 199 | 299 | 799 | 799 | 1,199 | 1,999 |

A minimum shown for a plan the product does not offer has no effect on that product.

## Equal payment plan APR

| Product | 24-month | 36-month | 48-month |
|---|---|---|---|
| Crestline Auto Care Card Starter, Crestline Auto Care Card, Crestline Auto Care Card Preferred and Crestline Auto Care Mastercard | 9.99% | 11.99% | 12.99% |
| Crestline Auto Care Mastercard Preferred | 8.99% | 10.99% | 11.99% |
| Crestline Auto Care World Mastercard | 7.99% | 9.99% | 10.99% |

## Terms common to every product

- **Plan length:** 6, 12, 18, 24, 36 or 48 calendar months from the purchase posting date, as the plan name says.
- **Where:** Crestline stores only.
- **Account current:** yes — the account must have no past-due amount on the purchase date.
- **Plans per ticket:** 1.
- **Equal payment fixed monthly payment:** rounded up to the cent.
- **Deferred interest:** accrues from the purchase date at the account's purchase APR.

Hypothetical reading: a 450 USD Crestline ticket on a Crestline Auto Care Card Preferred meets the 12-month deferred minimum of 399 USD; on a Crestline Auto Care Card the same ticket meets only the 6-month minimum, the 12-month minimum there being 499 USD.
